acceptance_criteria: Metric references and their observer/time/unit linkage are recorded explicitly in the resolved plan.
A metric reference without an explicit observer/time/unit link is rejected with a stable structured diagnostic.
No metric value is computed and no oracle is accessed.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall compile declared metric intent references and their explicit linkage to observers, scope, time domain, and units into the resolved plan, and shall not evaluate, compute, or execute any metric or oracle.
title: Metric intent references without evaluation
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
